verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents W-2 access through its 24/7 employee online portal, which is a distribution channel. It also claims to simplify 1099 reporting for contractors and to automatically handle tax filings. No evidence explicitly describes automatic year-end generation and delivery of W-2s and 1099s to workers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic year-end W-2/1099 generation, 1099 distribution to contractors (electronic or mailed), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
